packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major npm deps: every npm PR rewrites package-lock.json, so ungrouped they conflict with each other on every merge
One PR for all non-major GitHub Actions. Actions only (github-tags/github-digest): the same manager also reports node-version, which is a runtime bump and is reviewed by hand below

Automerge non-major npm and action updates once CI is green. No branch protection on this repo, so Renovate checks the status itself (platformAutomerge=false) and merges through a PR, because ci.yml only runs on pull requests. Rebased onto main first so the green run is against current main. Every merge to main is a production release of the public site, so the release age guards against compromised fresh publishes reaching it

Base image digests automerge. docker:pinDigests pins node:22-alpine to a digest, so Node patch releases and Alpine security fixes arrive as digest PRs, and merging one releases a fresh image: that is this repo's rebuild cadence, with no empty weekly rebuilds. No release age here: a digest update often has no release timestamp, and Renovate holds an update without one for good while minimumReleaseAge is set (minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour defaults to timestamp-required)
Runtime versions (the node base image tag, node-version in workflows) change the interpreter under everything, so they are reviewed by hand, and only open a PR once ticked on the Renovate Dashboard

Majors are reviewed by hand, and only open a PR once ticked on the Renovate Dashboard: a green major still needs someone to look at the site before the merge releases it, so an open PR nobody is about to review is just noise
